legend-norwegian-scenic-route-valdresfly.slogan: Norwegian Scenic Route Valdresflye – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-norwegian-scenic-route-valdresfly.story: Norwegian Scenic Route. plateau, Jotunheimen, lakes. 76 km from Heggenes to Vågåmo, about 1 h 23 of riding. The highest point is about 1,500 m. Valdresflye is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Valdresflye
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 16 km this is Norwegian Scenic Route Valdresflye, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
